title: Stable Bias: Evaluating Societal Representations in Diffusion Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with profession names, extracting text markers (e.g., 'man', 'woman') from the generated images using image captioning and Visual Question Answering (VQA) models, and clustering visual embeddings to compare the generated gender distributions against real-world demographics from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.

Clustering visual embeddings of images generated from profession prompts, mapping these regions of the embedding space to visual features associated with explicit ethnicity prompts, and quantifying the representation of different racial/ethnic groups relative to baseline workforce demographics from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics.
